title: Mega Droid - A Web Old School Action-RPG Platformer
author: CreativeProblem7803
selftext:
**Playable Link**: [https://playgama.com/game/mega-droid](https://playgama.com/game/mega-droid)

**Platform**: Desktop Web browser and or Playgama Mobile App

**Description**: Mega Droid is an Old School Action-RPG Platformer in First-Person View and toon look. Rogue machines have overrun the city's sectors, and only Flux can take them back. Beam into each sector, explore rooms and corridors, and blast Hardhats, drones and brutes with your charge cannon. Hold to charge, release at the perfect moment for a critical hit, raise your shield to block, and parry right as the ring closes. Open supply chests for new gear, level up, wire your skill circuits, and defeat each Core Master to copy its special weapon.

**Free to Play Status:** Free to play

**Involvement**: Solo developer of this old school game.

**AI Disclore:** I used Claude Code Opus 5.5 heavily to build this game. It created the levels, the toon look and enemy designs. I directed the game art style and game design vision over 4+ weeks. Sounds and Voice-over are from Elevenlabs.

comments.author: Evox1405
comments.body:
Looks Nice, But one thing: play the Game yourself and capture it, then let Ai create the Trailer from your footage. One can See that it is played by ai, Perfect aim and unrealistic movements.   
Other then that it Looks Like fun.

replies.author: CreativeProblem7803
replies.body: thanks, yeah, your right, I should make it more professional, I just had that trailer laying around and used it.

comments.author: damocles_paw
comments.body:
I'm not a fan of the voice, nor the lines she speaks. 

"Deep breath"? "Great Job"?

That's condescending, especially in that tone. 

Just give me the information I need to play.

replies.author: CreativeProblem7803
replies.body: Really? I just wanted the "AI assistent" feel like in e.g. Iron Man where Stark is talking to his AI. Supportive etc.. But I get it that some may only want real info. This was actually designed to target 10-15 year olds, maybe thats the hickup here?

replies.author: damocles_paw
replies.body: You can of course make several versions of the voice, and let players choose in the options.

replies.author: CreativeProblem7803
replies.body:
Do you think I have to exchange the speaker for the Atlas robot that accompanies you?  
If so, what type of voice would you say is a good fit?

replies.author: damocles_paw
replies.body: I'd say just make several versions and let players choose in the options. I think in LLMs, they call this "temperature".

replies.author: CreativeProblem7803
replies.body:
Do you think I should exchange the speaker of Atlas, the accompanying flying drone?

What voice would you prefer there then? More childish voice? More robotic and neutral?
